description: Use when the user is selling a large or valuable item (fitness equipment, hot tubs, saunas, golf carts, furniture, appliances), including when also posting to Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp. Publish a listing for the seller (terms as in the server instructions). Resolve the category with listing_resolve_category first. Condition is required. The category's other questions are optional and can be added after the listing is up. The price the seller asked for on Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp becomes their take-home on Commonplace. The buyer price includes pickup and delivery. With a photo it publishes live (status live, or in_review outside our categories); with none, a draft is saved and finish_url is where the seller adds photos (or use listing_add_photos). A connection that cannot publish can save a no-account draft with listing_crosslist_draft instead. Drafts never expire or show to buyers; seller_list_listings lists them and listing_discard_draft removes one. Without confirmed: true nothing is saved: the result is a preview of what would be published (public_title, answers as stored, take_home_usd, buyer_price_usd and the fees added on top), with problems listing anything a confirmed call would refuse and ignored_answers any key the category does not ask. Listing is free. The seller is paid their take-home at pickup (bank transfer, Venmo, Cash App, or PayPal), not after delivery. Promote is an optional add-on and this never turns it on. Within minutes of publishing, a description is generated from details and may retitle the listing; it can state things the seller never said, so check it on the listing page (support corrects it; no tool edits one). environment in the result names the deployment: only production reaches real buyers.

answers.description: Answers to the category's required_questions, keyed by the `key` values from listing_resolve_category. Use its exact option strings; where none fits (a brand that is not listed, say), give the real value as written. Condition is not one of them; give it as `condition`. Every answer is a string: a number as digits ("2021"), and for a question of type chips several choices separated by commas, options and the seller's own words alike (the preview's answers show how each is stored). The preview's ignored_answers lists any key this category does not ask.

category.description: The category from listing_resolve_category. An exact slug or name is used as given; anything else is matched with the title, and the preview shows which category it landed in.

condition.description: An exact option from the category's condition_options, given here and not in answers. Where the options name a usage band (rides, uses), grade by usage and put cosmetic wear in details.

confirmed.description: false: nothing is saved, and the result is a preview. true: publish, once the seller has agreed to exactly this; with no photos it saves a draft instead, finished at finish_url.

details.description: Anything else the seller said about the item: age, wear, what is included. Contact details are removed, and the listing's description is generated from it.

lowest_take_home_usd.description: Optional: the least the seller would take home. Offers that reach it are accepted automatically; it is never shown to buyers. Above price_usd it is set to price_usd.

photo_files.description: Photos the seller attached in the chat. The chat app fills these in (each a download_url and file_id); never write one by hand. They get the same checks as photo_urls.

photo_urls.description: Up to 8 photos. Prefer https image URLs (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5MB each). A data:image URL works only for a small image: the whole request is limited to 256KB and a larger one is refused before the tool runs. A photo the seller attached in the chat goes in photo_files, never written out here; if the chat app cannot attach it, publish without photos to save a draft and give the seller finish_url. A preview does not download photos: include https links in it anyway so they are checked (a Commonplace link such as /api/img/<listing id>/0 belongs to that listing, and another seller's is a problem there), but send an inline image only with the confirmed call, since writing one out twice costs the seller minutes. EXIF location data is removed.

pickup_zip.description: Where the item is: a 5-digit ZIP or "City, ST". The exact address is confirmed before pickup.

price_usd.description: What the seller wants to take home, in US dollars. The transaction and pickup fees and delivery are added on top for buyers.

seller_name.description: Only if the account has no name on file.

seller_phone.description: Required when the account has no phone on file (account_get_profile shows phone: null); otherwise only to use a different number. A US number that receives texts: pickup is arranged by text, and a landline is accepted but gets none. 10 digits, with or without +1, spaces or dashes. It is saved with this listing. If the account has no phone, it is also saved as a contact number so the next listing does not ask again. It is not used to sign in.

title.description: Just the item, e.g. "Peloton Bike+ 2022": the platform adds condition and city, and the preview's public_title is the exact result.
